subject: order markers of RILs by treat data as f2

messages.author: a88e586574ebf833
messages.subject: order markers of RILs by treat data as f2
parts:
Dear all,

  I am trying to build a dense framework map for a F7 population with 2.4k GBS markers. The 2.4k GBS markers are already filtered (missing =0% and MAF > 0.3) and about 3.14% of my data are heterozygotes.

  Because the “orderMarkers” is not available for ”bcsft”, it seems I should treat data as “riself”. However, all heterozygotes will be changed to missing if I treat data as “riself”.

 

  Does it appropriate to treat data as “f2” when I order the markers if I want to retain heterozygotes?

 

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] order markers of RILs by treat data as f2
parts:
I would be inclined to treat it as RIL by selfing and omit the heterozygotes.

karl
